global_invariants: Campaign, Scene and Session remain distinct governed aggregates and lifecycles.
Reusable Definitions remain in their owning domains; PPIA-08 stores stable references, Campaign-local composition, permitted overrides, placement, visibility, snapshots and history only.

Authorization and permission filtering occur before hidden existence, counts, labels, search, autocomplete, layers, errors, exports, diagnostics, notifications, AI context or other derived aggregates are resolved.
Uploaded map image bytes remain separate from grid calibration; grid alignment never destructively rewrites source image pixels.
Square-grid calibration uses cellSizePx plus originOffsetXPx and originOffsetYPx and grid translation remains distinct from camera pan and zoom.
Square-cell, multi-cell-area, named-zone and gridless semantic locations are first-class and stable under the version they reference.
Large objects use one placement over a governed area rather than cloning an owning object per cell.
All seven verified dungeon primitive families remain authoring geometry and do not infer collision, cover, line of sight, movement legality, damage, lighting, fog or balance.
Encounter/objective/trigger placement never transfers Encounter definition, simulation or final balance authority from MV-IA-F012/PPIA-11.
Launch snapshots pin exact Campaign, Scene, map asset, calibration, placement and visibility-policy versions; later authoring edits never silently rewrite an active Session.
Live Session changes require an attributable governed amendment path and post-session outcomes remain Campaign-local history.
Every authoritative mutation reauthorizes, revalidates versions, requires expected_version plus stable operation_id, and uses status/current-version lookup before retry after ambiguous outcomes.
Offline operation may preserve safe drafts but may not silently commit authoritative Campaign, map or Session state.
Every visual map, grid, layer, drag or geometry workflow has keyboard, touch, high-zoom/reflow, screen-reader and semantic nonvisual operation.
AI-assisted suggestions remain proposals; accepted state is produced only through the same governed owning actions and provenance rules as human-authored changes.
No workflow activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, testers, paid services or production credentials.

workflows.name: Campaign setup, policy, membership and bounded delegation
preconditions: filter protected policy and membership facts
steps: inspect Campaign policy and visible Scene summary
privacy_requirements: membership, delegation and protected policy facts are filtered before summaries or counts
recovery_requirements: policy and delegation writes use expected_version plus operation_id
reauthorize after role or membership change
forbidden_mutations: delegation cannot implicitly widen authority
Campaign policy cannot mutate reusable source Definitions

workflows.name: Scene hierarchy, templates and explicit branching
preconditions: filter hidden Scene existence before outline aggregation
steps: author explicit prerequisites, branch conditions, outcomes and alternate Scene links
privacy_requirements: hidden child Scenes and branches contribute nothing to unauthorized outlines or search
recovery_requirements: Scene and branch writes are versioned/idempotent
stale hierarchy writes fail without last-write-wins
forbidden_mutations: ordering alone cannot invent branch or causal semantics
unresolved conditions remain unresolved

workflows.name: Reusable source-reference placement preparation and local overrides
privacy_requirements: source candidates and local overrides are permission-filtered before search or previews
recovery_requirements: reference and override writes use expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: PPIA-08 never copies or rewrites the owning Definition
local override cannot escape its allowlist

workflows.name: Map-image asset upload, replacement and attribution
preconditions: obtain uploaded asset receipt and dimensions
steps: upload or select versioned map image
replace through a new asset or asset version when requested
preserve prior asset attribution and snapshot references
workflows.mutation_owner: asset/media owner plus PPIA-08 Scene association
privacy_requirements: protected map assets and thumbnails are filtered before serialization or export
recovery_requirements: upload/association writes are idempotent
replacement never loses prior snapshot attribution
forbidden_mutations: grid alignment never rewrites image bytes
replacement never silently rewrites an existing launch snapshot

workflows.name: Square-grid calibration, preview, lock and recalibration
preconditions: resolve current calibration version if any
camera state is treated as view-only
steps: pan/translate grid through originOffsetXPx and originOffsetYPx
preview alignment independently of camera pan/zoom
revise by creating a new calibration version when needed
privacy_requirements: hidden map associations or locations are not exposed through calibration previews
recovery_requirements: recalibration preserves prior versions
stale expected_version fails safely
ambiguous response uses operation-status lookup before retry
accessibility_requirements: numeric cell-size and X/Y offset fields
forbidden_mutations: camera pan/zoom cannot change calibration
no automatic distance-per-square, scale inference, rotation or hex requirement is invented

workflows.name: Cell, multi-cell-area, named-zone and semantic location authoring
preconditions: square locations reference exact calibration ID/version
steps: define single square cells when needed
define multi-cell areas or governed region geometry
privacy_requirements: hidden zones/locations are filtered before labels, counts and autocomplete
recovery_requirements: location writes use expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: square address does not invent real-world distance
visual geometry is not the only authoritative representation

workflows.name: Scene content placement, movement, layering and multi-cell occupancy
preconditions: authorize owning reference and target Scene/location
filter protected placements before layer aggregation
steps: place governed content through stable owning-object reference
use one area-backed placement for large objects
change presentation layer or z-order without touching owning Definition
privacy_requirements: hidden placements contribute nothing to unauthorized layer counts/search/errors/exports/AI context
recovery_requirements: placement writes are idempotent
compatible duplicate retry returns prior result and never duplicates placement
forbidden_mutations: placement never owns or clones source Definition
large object is not duplicated once per occupied cell

workflows.name: Hidden content, knowledge state and governed reveal
preconditions: authorize subject/role projection before resolving protected object existence
steps: author or retain GM-private placement state
recompute only authorized projection after accepted change
privacy_requirements: hidden existence is filtered before counts, labels, search, autocomplete, layers, errors, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI context
recovery_requirements: reveal mutation uses expected_version plus operation_id
revocation forces reauthorization and cache/projection invalidation
forbidden_mutations: client-side hiding is insufficient
unauthorized aggregate may not reveal that hidden content exists

workflows.name: Basic dungeon construction and semantic geometry editing
steps: create room/floor, corridor/path, wall, door/opening, terrain/feature, stairs/portal/transition or reusable tile/stamp
maintain semantic description alongside render geometry
privacy_requirements: hidden dungeon elements are filtered before player render and semantic projections
recovery_requirements: geometry create/edit/duplicate/remove is expected-version checked and idempotent
undo/redo resolves to governed mutation history rather than untracked client state
forbidden_mutations: geometry cannot invent collision, cover, LOS, movement, damage, lighting, fog or balance
procedural generation is not required

workflows.name: Encounter, objective, trigger and event-link authoring
preconditions: authorize Scene and referenced owning object
steps: bind explicit trigger condition when supplied
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-08 link adapter; owning Encounter rules remain external
privacy_requirements: hidden encounters/objectives/triggers are filtered before counts, previews and AI context
recovery_requirements: link write uses expected_version plus operation_id
accessibility_requirements: screen-reader link kind, owner, location and trigger summary
forbidden_mutations: PPIA-08 cannot simulate or rebalance Encounter
geometry or placement cannot infer tactical outcomes

workflows.name: Launch readiness, immutable snapshot and Session binding
preconditions: resolve exact candidate Campaign, Scene, map, calibration, placement and visibility-policy versions
filter hidden findings to authorized launch role
steps: surface blocking findings without hidden leakage
create immutable launch snapshot and Session-binding inputs
privacy_requirements: readiness errors cannot disclose hidden placement existence to unauthorized users
recovery_requirements: snapshot creation requires exact readiness receipt/version set and idempotent operation ID
forbidden_mutations: launch snapshot cannot float to latest versions
snapshot cannot be silently rewritten after Session begins

workflows.name: Governed live-Session amendment proposal and decision
preconditions: resolve immutable launch snapshot and current amendment chain
steps: emit durable amendment event when accepted
privacy_requirements: amendment projections reveal only refs/fields authorized for the viewer
recovery_requirements: proposal and decision use distinct stable operation IDs
ambiguous decision status is checked before retry
forbidden_mutations: live edit cannot silently rewrite launch snapshot
unaccepted proposal cannot mutate active Session

workflows.name: Post-session outcome, history and reusable-definition isolation
preconditions: resolve Session and current Campaign-local outcome version
steps: route any proposed reusable-definition change back to its owning domain rather than applying it here
recovery_requirements: outcome write is idempotent
history inspection can resolve operation status and current versions
forbidden_mutations: post-session outcome cannot rewrite reusable Setting, Creature/NPC, Item, Vehicle or Species/Form Definitions

workflows.name: Reconnect, stale-write conflict and ambiguous-operation recovery
steps: query operation status before retry after ambiguous response
surface current version and conflict-safe choices
return prior result for compatible duplicate operation ID
workflows.mutation_owner: MV-IA-F021 recovery protocol around owning action
privacy_requirements: error and recovery data cannot disclose hidden object existence
recovery_requirements: status-before-retry is mandatory
same operation ID cannot create duplicate authoritative state
offline authoritative map/Session commit remains forbidden
forbidden_mutations: no blind last-write-wins
no retry with a fresh operation ID merely because response was lost

workflows.name: Semantic nonvisual map, Scene and history authoring
preconditions: resolve same IDs/versions used by visual surface
steps: navigate Scene hierarchy by ordered semantic list
navigate cells/areas/zones/placements by text and keyboard
inspect or invoke permitted actions without drag/color/hover dependence
reauthorize after revocation or role change
workflows.mutation_owner: none; invokes same owning action contracts when mutation is requested
privacy_requirements: semantic alternatives apply identical server-side filtering as visual projections
recovery_requirements: reconnect/deep links reauthorize and revalidate versions
forbidden_mutations: visual map cannot be sole authoritative representation
accessibility projection cannot be a less-private or less-governed data path

workflows.name: Gridless Scene authoring and placement
preconditions: authorize semantic location and owning object
steps: define named or described semantic location
move or relayer through semantic controls
inspect same content through accessible list projection
privacy_requirements: gridless does not weaken hidden-placement filtering
recovery_requirements: location and placement writes retain the same expected-version/idempotency protocol as gridded mode
accessibility_requirements: gridless semantic locations are natively text-addressable
forbidden_mutations: grid is never mandatory for Scene authoring
pixel coordinates cannot become an accidental requirement

workflows.name: Post-launch map replacement or recalibration isolation and adoption
preconditions: an existing launch snapshot pins prior asset/calibration versions
authorize authoring and any live amendment separately
steps: create new map asset version and/or calibration version without changing active Session
either create a new launch snapshot for future/new Session or propose explicit live amendment
accept/reject live adoption through governed decision path
outputs: new snapshot or governed amendment receipt
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-08 authoring plus MV-IA-F005 live amendment authority
privacy_requirements: new map/calibration versions remain permission-filtered; hidden placements do not leak through recalibration or readiness findings
recovery_requirements: all new asset/calibration/snapshot/amendment writes retain independent operation IDs and expected versions
prior versions remain recoverable/attributable
accessibility_requirements: textual comparison of prior/new asset/calibration versions
forbidden_mutations: later asset or calibration edit cannot silently reposition active Session
authoring version is not automatically adopted into live play
